canonicalPolicy.ahrefsDomainRating: Prefer the value observed directly in Ahrefs for the same root domain. Third-party Ahrefs-powered checkers remain comparison evidence only when they disagree.
canonicalPolicy.backlinkCounts: Never merge backlink counts across providers. Keep Ahrefs and SE Ranking backlink/referring-domain counts separate because each provider uses its own index.
canonicalPolicy.interpretation: Backlink volume is not equivalent to Domain Rating. DR depends primarily on unique followed referring domains and their link profiles.

ahrefsDirect.note: Direct Ahrefs UI observation supplied by the owner. API connector cannot independently verify on the current plan.

tinyStartups.note: Tiny Startups states its DR leaderboard is refreshed weekly. This value conflicts materially with the direct Ahrefs observation and must not replace it.

seRanking.note: SE Ranking uses its own backlink index and authority metric; these values are not Ahrefs DR.

reconciliation.reason: Provider indexes and refresh cadences differ. Tiny Startups is a weekly third-party cache while direct Ahrefs is the canonical Ahrefs observation. Backlink totals from Ahrefs and SE Ranking are intentionally kept separate.
